resources.string: Search only covers session and workspace IDs already loaded for the selected runtime and within your current permissions. It also covers native session and workspace names if you have permission to read them. It does not search message text, paths, or other computers.
Check the session or workspace name or ID, or reset the filters. Names may not be available. Search excludes other computers and directory entries that have not been loaded.
Only sessions opened during this use of the app appear here. Each entry is checked against the current runtime’s directory and read permissions.

Status and workspace filters apply only to authorized directory entries already loaded. They do not make requests or read message text. Not archived includes available sessions, sessions with tasks in progress, and currently unavailable sessions. Workspace options come only from those directory entries.
